坐直或站稳，双臂随节拍缓慢抬起并打开，再缓慢回落。: Sit upright or stand steadily. Slowly raise and open both arms to the beat, then lower them slowly.
脚跟并拢、脚尖向外，双臂在身前形成圆形，保持躯干直立。: Place your heels together with toes turned outward. Hold your arms in a circle in front of you and keep your trunk upright.
双臂抬至身前圆形: Raise both arms into a circle in front of you
扶椅站稳，一条腿沿地面缓慢伸出、脚尖点地，再缓慢收回。: Stand steadily with chair support. Slowly extend one leg along the floor, touch your toes to the floor, then slowly bring the leg back.
脚尖点地: Touch your toes to the floor
扶椅浅屈膝: Shallow knee bend with chair support
扶稳固定椅背，双脚自然站立，双膝小幅弯曲后缓慢伸直。不需要把脚尖转向外侧，也不要: Hold the back of a stable chair securely and stand with your feet in a natural position. Bend both knees slightly, then slowly straighten them. There is no need to turn your toes outward. Do not squat deeply.
随节拍把重心缓慢移向一侧，同时手臂向对侧打开，再移回另一侧。: Slowly shift your weight to one side to the beat while opening your arms toward the opposite side, then shift your weight to the other side.
重心移向右侧: Shift your weight to the right
手臂向左侧打开: Open your arms to the left
重心移向左侧: Shift your weight to the left
手臂向右侧打开: Open your arms to the right
